notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Darksteel Splicer, adding {R}.
When Darksteel Splicer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Darksteel Splicer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Darksteel Splicer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least one 3/3 Phyrexian Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability three times by sacrificing three Phyrexian Golems, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
If you have four or more opponents, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and red mana.
